set.body: Complete the existing recording-plan seam (PRD APP-1/APP-2): I-DT in angular units and Engbert-Kliegl microsaccades with explicitly supplied per-axis thresholds. Add typed parameters, RecordingMethod values, scientific descriptors and checked versioned codecs. Reuse existing canonical detectors; do not hide whole-trial threshold estimation inside a streaming method. Verify direct/interpreted/saved-reloaded equality, independently specified parameters and event expectations, malformed parameters, schema/method mismatch and inspect/preflight behavior on JVM/JS. Preserve I-VT v1 compatibility and document the threshold-estimation and synchronous-execution boundaries.
